## Change and scope

What behavior does this add or fix? Is this a new device, firmware, protocol or platform?

## Compatibility and evidence

- Device/product:
- Exact firmware:
- Platform/OS:
- Commands/layouts checked:
- Evidence level: documented / synthetic-tested / hardware-verified
- Unknown fields, units, unsupported versions and other limitations:

Do not include personal captures, actual health values, device identifiers or secrets.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any untested platform or hardware path.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Device/firmware catalog and protocol documentation reflect the verified scope.
- [ ] Relevant synthetic vectors and implemented platform tests/builds pass.
- [ ] Existing APIs remain compatible, or breaking changes are explained.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under MIT; external code/dependencies retain their actual licenses and notices.
- [ ] The diff contains no personal captures/identifiers, proprietary SDK artifacts or machine-specific paths.
